change: Added a 'Status Remark' log to Breakdown Register -- a running, timestamped feed of updates (e.g. 'Mechanic arrived, assessing', 'Waiting for spare part') that anyone can add to via the Edit modal, distinct from Work Done which is a single overwritable field. Each entry is stamped with date/time and shown newest-first in the Edit modal, and the latest update also surfaces directly on the card (blue-accented note) so anyone monitoring the register can see what's currently happening without opening Edit.
